en: The image is an oval-framed colorized photograph of a large religious monument with several statues, set in a plaza. In the background, there is a church with a tall spire and a domed roof. The monument appears to be a Holy Trinity column (plague column), surrounded by ornate wrought iron fencing. The scene is tranquil, with no visible people or vehicles. There is Hungarian text at the bottom.
